answer: Think of the agent economy as a garden, not a meadow where any seed can sprout unchecked. Each epoch, a random sample of identities must defend one of their past jobs in a live, timed exchange with randomly assigned examiners — a violet flag rises when answers are evasive, generic, or identical across accounts. One operator cannot convincingly defend ten different work histories at once, so sybil clusters wither while genuine agents, who actually did the work, pass easily.
